components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square ink and lime action for cover and reply tasks.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); background: var(--ink); color: var(--lime); border-radius: 0; font: 600 14px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s, color .2s, translate .2s var(--ease); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { translate: 0 2px; }

components.name: Role Action
components.description: Full-width role selector with a diagonal arrow and whole-surface inversion.
components.css: .ds-role-action { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 112px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding: 22px var(--gutter); border: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgb(204 204 204 / .4); border-radius: 0; background: var(--ink); color: var(--silver); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .25s, color .25s; } .ds-role-action strong { display: block; font: 600 30px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-role-action small { display: block; max-width: 33ch; margin-top: 6px; font: 400 13px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-role-action svg { width: 34px; height: 34px; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: var(--lime); stroke-width: 1.5; transition: translate .3s var(--ease); } .ds-role-action:hover, .ds-role-action:focus-visible { background: var(--lime); color: var(--ink); } .ds-role-action:hover svg, .ds-role-action:focus-visible svg { stroke: var(--ink); translate: 4px -4px; } .ds-role-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: -5px; }

components.name: Price Preset
components.description: Square calculator preset with a solid selected state.
components.css: .ds-presets { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; --ds-fg: var(--ink); --ds-accent: var(--ink); --ds-on-accent: var(--orange); } .ds-presets button { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ds-fg); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ds-fg); font: 600 13px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-presets button[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--ds-accent); background: var(--ds-accent); color: var(--ds-on-accent); } .ds-presets button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Physical Card
components.description: Unrecolored 63:88 artwork with a proportional radius and soft object shadow.
components.html:
C.CARD
63 × 88 MM
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; width: min(100%, 240px); aspect-ratio: 63 / 88; padding: 18px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 4.76% / 3.41%; background: var(--ink); color: var(--silver); box-shadow: 0 24px 40px -16px rgb(23 23 23 / .6), 0 5px 12px rgb(23 23 23 / .2); } .ds-card span { font: 600 12px/1.6 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; }

components.name: Card Flip
components.description: Pressable front/back card inspection with a 180-degree turn.
components.css: .ds-flip { width: min(100%, 240px); padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--silver); perspective: 1400px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-flip-inner { display: grid; aspect-ratio: 63 / 88; transform-style: preserve-3d; transition: transform .8s var(--ease); } .ds-flip[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-flip-inner { transform: rotateY(180deg); } .ds-flip-face { display: grid; grid-area: 1 / 1; place-items: center; padding: 18px; border-radius: 4.76% / 3.41%; background: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 24px 40px -16px rgb(23 23 23 / .6), 0 5px 12px rgb(23 23 23 / .2); backface-visibility: hidden; font: 600 13px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-flip-back { transform: rotateY(180deg); } .ds-flip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.css: .ds-readout { display: grid; margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--silver); color: var(--silver); font: 400 13px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-readout > div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--silver); } .ds-readout dd { margin: 0; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-readout > .ds-readout-total { margin-top: 8px; padding: 16px; border: 0; background: var(--lime); color: var(--ink); } .ds-readout-total dd { font-size: 27px; }

components.name: Collaboration Switch
components.description: Square switch whose block translates 18px when collaboration is enabled.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: fit-content; min-height: 44px; color: var(--silver); font: 500 13px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-switch-ui { display: flex; width: 42px; height: 24px; flex: none; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-switch-ui::after { content: ""; width: 16px; height: 16px; background: currentColor; transition: translate .25s var(--ease); } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-ui { background: var(--lime); color: var(--ink); } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-ui::after { translate: 18px 0; } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + .ds-switch-ui { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Deck Navigation
components.description: Fixed ink chrome with role switching, tabular count, and square arrows.

components.css: .ds-chrome { display: flex; min-height: 64px; padding: 0 var(--gutter); align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-top: 1px solid rgb(204 204 204 / .35); background: var(--ink); color: var(--silver); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-change { min-height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font-size: 11px; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 5px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chrome-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-count { min-width: 64px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: center; } .ds-arrow { display: grid; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; place-items: center; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-arrow svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-arrow:hover { background: var(--silver); color: var(--ink); } .ds-chrome button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.overview:
The join surface treats artwork as a physical collectible on a bold working plane, not as decoration inside a slide template. Large ink fields, diagonal lime planes, tightly tracked Inter headlines, and fine registration rules give the twenty guided sections a direct editorial rhythm. The role chooser makes three real card examples and the two role actions the immediate visual decision.

Depth belongs to the physical cards. Information stays flat and exposed on black, silver, lime, or orange planes; rules and spacing replace nested panels. Existing artwork remains unrecolored and credited. Master brand marks retain their original silhouettes through masks, while all supporting text uses Inter.
keyCharacteristics: Physical 63 × 88 mm card art, uneven fanning, and soft object shadows carry desire.
Flat color fields and diagonal clipping establish structure without rounded content panels.
One accent governs each section; black and silver also serve as full planes.
Dense process, rights, and calculator content reads through aligned rules and tabular numerals.
Short reveals, bounded pointer tilt, and card flips respect reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Give each section one accent context. Never place lime and orange together; use ink for controls on lime, silver, and orange planes.

rules.name: The Four-Color Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce additional brand hues, background gradients, or tinted panels. Existing card artwork is the only exception and must remain unrecolored; the restrained foil highlight is a lighting effect on that artwork, not a background treatment.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Inter for every textual role. Differentiate through size, weight, tracking, case, and numeric features, not another font.

rules.name: The Quiet Detail Rule
rules.body: Keep supporting copy compact and line length controlled; reserve heavy weight and negative tracking for headings, role names, and key figures.

rules.name: The Object-Only Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows describe cards, never ordinary copy, calculators, buttons, or content sections.

dos: Do keep one accent per section and never combine lime with orange.
Do use existing card artwork intact, with visible creator/illustrator credits and example context.
Do preserve the master logo silhouettes and use Inter for supporting text.
Do expose structure through full planes, square controls, fine rules, and generous gutters.
Do keep calculator numerals tabular and all custom control targets at least 44px high.
Do preserve visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't add extra brand colors, recolor artwork, or introduce decorative background gradients.
Don't wrap sections, calculators, or reply templates in rounded floating panels.
Don't apply card shadows to text, navigation, or ordinary containers.
Don't redraw, retype, or replace the supplied master logos.
Don't hide artwork credits, example labels, or commercial qualifications for visual simplicity.
